title: Coefficient data on a homogeneous localization
statement: Under the hypotheses of coefficient homomorphism, there is a function from the homogeneous localization to sections preserving zero, one, addition, and multiplication, and satisfying the numerator coefficient equation.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (local quotient construction and comparison) and 01NK (different positive degrees)

proof.text: Obtain c and its numerator equation from exists_sectionRing_coefficient_numerator.
Apply sectionRing_coefficient_arithmetic_of_numerator to c and its equation, then combine the four arithmetic laws and the numerator equation into the required existential conjunction.

proof_origin.note: Split the documented coefficient construction into numerator existence and arithmetic consequences.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_sectionRing_coefficient_data
    (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) (hd : 0 < d) (U : X.Opens)
    (hs : IsFreeGenerator ((L.tensorPow d).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (s.val d))) :
    ∃ c : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val → Γ(X, U),
      c 0 = 0 ∧ c 1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ a b, c (a + b) = c a + c b) ∧
      (∀ a b, c (a * b) = c a * c b) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
        c (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
            ξ.val ξ.property) •
          (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
            ((s.val ^ n) (n • d)) =
        (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
          (ξ.val (n • d)))
